original.target_description: Original Study 1 could not be examined: no accessible full paper acquired within the acquisition limit.

replication.target_description: Located full replication paper and p.5 Results equivalent (HTML section 4): chocolate confectionary ANOVA comparing number of brands purchased at 10–11am versus 3–4pm in a UK individual purchasing panel. The sample includes multiple age groups and the outcome is number of brands purchased, rather than a young-adult leader-versus-follower brand choice test.

n.sample_role: Analytic n for the chocolate confectionary ANOVA is not established. The reported panel total is 1097 individuals; this is not assumed to be the target-test analytic sample.

reported_success.quote: rather than the compensating mechanism suggested by Roehm and Roehm (2004).

notes: Original full text unavailable: DOI landing route failed, Springer PDF returned non-PDF HTML, OpenAlex and Unpaywall reported no open-access location, and a targeted open-access search found no original full paper. No original statistics were taken from the replication background. Replication title and DOI verified against the supplied reference. The chocolate confectionary comparison is the closest located outcome; the source locator does not specify a category, and no leader-versus-follower or young-adult subgroup test was found. Target mismatch is explicit. The replication prints group means 3.00 (10–11am) and 3.65 (3–4pm), but no mean difference or ANOVA F statistic; es remains null and no difference was computed. Other category comparisons were not merged: soft drinks p < 0.05 and crisps p > 0.05. Reported failure is the author narrative rejecting the Roehm and Roehm compensating mechanism, rather than an inference from significance. Analytic n is not equated with the generic panel total.
